title: Python command-line tool
description: Installable Python CLI (pyproject, console script, argparse subcommands, JSON output option) with tests, packaged into a single-file executable by PyInstaller.
produces: pip-installable package with a console command
build: Build mode creates .venv, installs the package + PyInstaller, runs the tests and packages dist/__APP_NAME__
Windows .exe: run build_exe.bat on Windows, or use the 'Build executables' GitHub workflow
customize: src/__PKG_NAME__/cli.py build_parser(): add subcommands and options
src/__PKG_NAME__/core.py: the actual logic, kept free of argparse so it's easy to test
